description_en: Unbinds an API from an access control list (ACL)
description_zh: 解除API与IP访问控制的绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi remove-ip-control-apis --ip-control-id dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --group-id 0009db9c828549768a200320714b8930 --api-ids 123 --stage-name TEST --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveIpControlApis

parameters.help_zh: 指定要操作的IP访问控制ID
parameters.name: ip_control_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the APIs from which you want to unbind the ACL.

- If this parameter is not specified, the ACL is unbound from all the APIs in the specified environment of the API group.

- The IDs of APIs that you want to query. Separate multiple API IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 API IDs can be entered
parameters.help_zh:
指定要解绑的API。

- 若不传入：默认解绑该分组该环境下的所有API。
- 指定要查询的API编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
parameters.name: api_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**

- **TEST**
parameters.help_zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **TEST**: 测试
parameters.name: stage_name
